assumptions_for_human_review: Design sections 3-4 explicitly require network access or a complete default-extra wheelhouse for the first bare-recipe upgrade. Offline reuse without uv applies after successful repair and validation, not to an unprepared legacy volume.

Design section 6 and PRD AC6 intentionally limit the Docker gate to loading the real packaged EJS bundles under Deno. This does not establish cookie-dependent YouTube extraction, PO Token availability, SABR behavior, or the video's AVC/HEVC format availability.
